title: NT-SB

source.dataset: psychonautwiki_db.zip (psychonautwiki.db, SQLite export provided by Hany, file dated 2026-11-25)

plain_text:
N-Tryptamine acid butanoyl (also known as NT-SB) is a lesser-known novel psychedelic substance. It is known as a powerful and dangerous deliriant and poison. The precise mechanism in the brain is not known.

NT-SB has been sold online as a research chemical since 2023. A larger number of deaths have been linked to its use.

History and culture

The original synthesis of NT-SB was first recorded sometime in 2022, by Canadian chemist
Nicholas Tomniuk in Victoria, BC. Sometime in 2023, it started showing up in the online
research chemical market.

'''''N-Tryptamine acid butanoyl''''' (also known as '''NT-SB''') is a lesser-known novel [[Psychoactive class::psychedelic]] substance. It is known as a powerful and dangerous [[psychoactive class::deliriant|deliriants]] and poison. The precise mechanism in the brain is not known.

NT-SB has been sold online as a [[research chemical]] since 2023. A larger number of deaths have been linked to its use.

==History and culture==
The original synthesis of NT-SB was first recorded sometime in 2022, by Canadian chemist
Nicholas Tomniuk in Victoria, BC. Sometime in 2023, it started showing up in the online
